clue.text: Ghost is one consumed by rage

indicators.note: something consumed by another is swallowed up inside it, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: rage means wrath
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A spirit described as eaten up with fury.
explanation.definitionFit: A wraith is a spectre or apparition, so it is a synonym for a spirit of the dead.

clue.text: Promise drama and witty repartee

parts.note: to give your word is to promise
a play is a drama

explanation.surface: A promise of theatre and sparkling dialogue.
explanation.definitionFit: Clever puns and verbal games are the stuff of quick-fire banter.

clue.text: A sundial fixed by artisan initially in part of Spain

indicators.note: fixed as in rearranged, so these letters are reworked

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: initially takes only the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: A craftsman repairs a sundial somewhere in Spain.
explanation.definitionFit: Andalusia is the southernmost region of Spain, home to Seville and Granada.

clue.text: Heads of the army caught knight in course of action

indicators.note: heads are the first letters of each of the following words

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
K is the chess notation for knight

explanation.surface: The army chiefs captured a knight while deciding their strategy.
explanation.definitionFit: A tack is a chosen approach or line of policy, from a sailing ship's heading.

clue.text: Husband having no weapons in safe

parts.note: without arms, i.e. armless

explanation.surface: A husband who carries no weapons is no danger to anyone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Arms' in the weapon sense gives ARMLESS, a pun on the limb sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that cannot hurt you is innocuous, so the two words are synonyms.

clue.text: Disinclined to mix in a party

parts.note: a social is a party or gathering

explanation.surface: A wallflower hanging back at a party.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who avoids company and conversation is unsociable.

clue.text: Mad chemist raging and discordant

indicators.note: raging letters are thrown wildly about into a new order

explanation.surface: A furious, unhinged scientist who is quite out of tune.
explanation.definitionFit: Things that clash or do not go together are ill-matched and jarring.

clue.text: Half of line covered by green bacteria

indicators.note: in a down clue, a piece covered by another sits beneath it, so it comes after

parts.note: eco is a prefix meaning environmentally green

indicators.note: half of the word, its first two letters

explanation.surface: Half a line of a page is covered in green bacterial growth.
explanation.definitionFit: E. coli is a common gut bacterium, notorious in food poisoning.

clue.text: Swindle involving river train

indicators.note: involving means taking in, so one piece is placed inside

parts.note: a sting is a confidence trick

explanation.surface: A con trick involving a train crossing a river.
explanation.definitionFit: A string of things is a series or line, as a train of camels or events.

clue.text: Something healing scientist drops first

indicators.note: drops says letters are removed from the word

parts.note: a physicist is a scientist
first is written 1st, read as IST

explanation.surface: A scientist drops everything to find a cure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'First' is written 1st, and the 1 is read as the letter I, giving IST.
explanation.definitionFit: Physic is an old word for medicine, a remedy.

clue.text: Salad ingredient two hundred welcome during broadcast

indicators.note: during places these letters within the span of the other piece

parts.note: a broadcast can be called radio
CC is two hundred in Roman numerals
hi is a word of welcome

explanation.surface: A radio show welcomes two hundred people to a cookery segment about salad.
explanation.definitionFit: Radicchio is a bitter red-leaved chicory eaten raw among mixed leaves.

clue.text: Search scrub

definitions.meaning: to ... an area is to search it thoroughly

explanation.surface: Two verbs for thorough work, hunting and cleaning.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb has two senses: combing a place for something, and rubbing a surface clean.

clue.text: Little piggies returned holding wolf skin?

indicators.note: returned says the hidden letters are read backwards
the words Little piggies hold the letters within them, across the word break

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: The little pigs come home carrying the skin of the big bad wolf.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft took 'holding' into the definition, but it is the hiding signal: the clue words hold the letters, read backwards. 'Returned' reverses them.
explanation.definitionFit: An animal's hide with its fur is a pelt; the question mark marks a wolf's as one example.

clue.text: Respect valuation opinion

definitions.meaning: holding someone in high esteem or regard
an assessment of worth or cost
a judgement, as in 'in my view'

explanation.surface: Three nouns listed for judging something's worth.
explanation.definitionFit: The noun covers esteem for a person, an appraisal of value, and a personal judgement.

clue.text: Last shogun organised attacks

indicators.note: organised letters are set into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: The final Japanese warlord planned his assaults.
explanation.definitionFit: Onslaughts are fierce assaults or charges, synonyms for military strikes.

clue.text: As a rule Sun has nice characters upset

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for Sunday

indicators.note: the characters of the word nice are upset, knocked into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A tabloid newspaper, the Sun, generally upsets nice people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'As a rule' looks like a stock phrase, but 'As' alone is the definition: As is the chemical symbol for arsenic.
explanation.definitionFit: As is the symbol of the element in the periodic table, a classic crossword trick.

clue.text: Vegetation right outside church

indicators.note: outside says the first piece goes round the second

parts.note: a lien is a legal right to hold property until a debt is paid

explanation.surface: Plants growing just outside the church on the right side.
explanation.walkthrough: A lien is a legal right to keep another's property until a debt is paid.
explanation.definitionFit: Lichen is a crusty growth on stone and bark, loosely counted as plant life.

clue.text: Pack up before lecture becomes complicated

indicators.note: before puts the first piece ahead of the next
in a down clue, up means the word is read from bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: a bale is a packed bundle
to orate is to lecture

explanation.surface: Packing up ahead of a lecture becomes a fuss.
explanation.definitionFit: Something intricate and detailed, with many parts, is involved and complex.

clue.text: 12 spots family

definitions.note: the solution to 12 across, an animal skin

parts.note: moles are spots on the skin
kin means family

explanation.surface: A family of animals with markings on its coat.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the answer to 12 across, PELT.
explanation.definitionFit: Moleskin is the soft fur of the mole, an animal hide.

clue.text: Time to get permit for rendered fat

parts.note: permit means allow

explanation.surface: It is time to get a licence to render animal fat.
explanation.definitionFit: Tallow is the hard fat melted down from suet, used for candles and soap.

clue.text: Got the best of fine fabric

definitions.meaning: to defeat, past tense of the verb to worst
a smooth twisted woollen yarn and cloth

explanation.surface: Someone outdid a rival in fine cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: The past tense of worst means defeated; the noun is a woollen cloth named after a Norfolk village.

clue.text: Ecstasy in heart perhaps before love leaves

indicators.note: before puts the first piece ahead of the next
in places one piece within the other

parts.note: the heart is an example of an organ
E is slang for the drug ecstasy
love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: Someone in raptures leaves just before love departs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leaves' reads as a verb of departure but is the noun, the herb's leaves.
explanation.definitionFit: Oregano is a herb whose dried leaves flavour Italian cooking.

clue.text: Compose carol about start of unity of vision

indicators.note: about says the rearranged letters go round the next piece
compose means arrange afresh, so these letters are reordered
the start of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Write a carol about the start of a new unity of vision.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Compose' rearranges CAROL to OCLAR, which goes 'about' U from 'unity'.
explanation.definitionFit: Ocular is the adjective relating to the eye and sight.

clue.text: Fire republican in jacket

parts.note: a blaze is a fire

explanation.surface: Sack a Republican official who wears a jacket.
explanation.definitionFit: A blazer is a smart, often striped or school, coat of jacket style.

clue.text: A slug on our ground is lethargic

indicators.note: ground as in crushed, so these letters are broken up and remade

explanation.surface: A slug crawling on our ground moves sluggishly.
explanation.definitionFit: Languorous describes a pleasantly lazy, listless state, a synonym of sluggish and inert.

clue.text: Material held by many longshoremen

indicators.note: held by means the letters sit inside these words, across the word break

explanation.surface: Cloth carried by lots of dockworkers.
explanation.definitionFit: Nylon is a synthetic fibre and the fabric made from it.

clue.text: Brownies regularly dropped anvil perhaps

indicators.note: every other letter of the word is dropped, keeping the regular remainder

explanation.surface: Brownie cakes are routinely dropped on an anvil.
explanation.walkthrough: The anvil, or incus, is one of the three tiny bones of the middle ear.
explanation.definitionFit: The incus is called the anvil for its shape, so it is an example of a bone.

clue.text: Mythical beast besides setter

parts.note: yet can mean besides, in addition
the setter of the puzzle refers to themselves as I

explanation.surface: A legendary creature stands beside the puzzle compiler.
explanation.definitionFit: The yeti is the legendary abominable snowman of the Himalayas.

clue.text: Nick losing head following unknown love

indicators.note: following puts the second piece after the first

parts.note: Z is an unknown in algebra

indicators.note: the first letter of the word is lost

parts.note: to nick is to steal, to filch

explanation.surface: A thief is caught after falling for a mysterious lover.
explanation.definitionFit: Love is zero in tennis scoring, and zilch is slang for nothing at all.

clue.text: Backward arrow on e-book brand

indicators.note: backward says the word is read from end to start

parts.note: a dart is a small arrow
Mark is a book of the New Testament

explanation.surface: An e-book displays a backward arrow symbol.
explanation.definitionFit: A trademark is a registered name or logo identifying a company's goods, like a brand.

clue.text: Call team to edge of fighting area

parts.note: to ring someone is to call them on the phone
a side is a team

explanation.surface: A coach summons the squad to the boundary of the boxing area.
explanation.definitionFit: Ringside is the area immediately beside a boxing ring, its border.

clue.text: Opine about gripping head of game bird

indicators.note: gripping says the rearranged letters hold the next piece inside them
about means moved around, so these letters are rearranged
the head of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Someone gives views on gripping game birds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'About' rearranges OPINE to PIEON, which then grips G from 'game'.
explanation.definitionFit: A pigeon is a common bird, here also hunted as game.
